thread:
leah: Kicking off Orion Medical POC. They emphasized PHI, EU data residency, SSO (SAML + optional OIDC), SCIM (HR <-> Redwood), RBAC by department, and domain allowlist for sign-in. They also asked about HIPAA BAAs and log retention. Who can help list the preflight items?

mike: Hosted POC ok, but HIPAA requires BAA + additional controls. For Hosted we can do a scoped BAA during eval but some features (BYOK) are Dedicated-only. Need clarity from legal whether they require on-prem eventually.

raj: SCIM details: support bulk import + delta sync; deltas kept 7 days by default in Hosted, can be extended. Rate limit: 100 req/min/tenant; 429 includes Retry-After. Recommend backoff: 500ms, 1s, 2s. Provide SCIM token scoped to tenant for POC.

gina: RBAC: we map SCIM groups -> Redwood roles. Ask customer for CSV mapping: department, group-id, target-role. We can also do attribute-based rules if their IdP emits orgUnit claims.

elaine: I'll attach SOC2 excerpt and HIPAA overview to the ticket. Note: for EU residency we can pin region; for Dedicated/Private we support BYOK and HSM integrations. BAA turnaround ~3-5 business days.

presales-bot: Created POC ticket POC-1845670000. Checklist: idp-metadata, scim-sandbox-token, rbac-csv, security-docs, hipaa-baa, audit-retention-quote.

leah: They asked about SAML NameID formats and SP-initiated flows; are there known quirks?

raj: We accept transient or persistent NameID; we recommend persistent for account linking across sessions. SP-init works; if they need IdP-initiated we provide ACS endpoints. Also OIDC supported for modern IdPs.

mike: Pricing note for sales: 60-day POC credits for enterprise, HIPAA-enabled tenancy is billable (controls + legal). Extended audit logs (90+ days) are add-on. I'll draft a one-pager.

leah: Domain proofing: they want to automate verification across multiple subdomains. We support org-level DNS TXT (delegated proof) or per-host file upload. Documented flow: provide token -> add TXT _redwood-verification.<domain> -> call our verify endpoint.

gina: Also confirm SCIM workflow: do they want full sync daily + deltas in near-real-time? That affects rate planning.

leah: I'll ask; prefer delta + daily full as default.

presales-bot: Reminder: schedule kickoff call: https://cal.redwood.io/poc/1845670000

leah: Action items: Elaine = upload SOC/HIPAA docs, Raj = SCIM sample payloads + RBAC CSV template, Mike = pricing one-pager, Gina = domain-proof runbook snippet. I'll send the questionnaire response draft to their legal tomorrow. :thumbsup:
